Title: Register new user
Steps:
1) Open app
2) Sign up with email/password/name
3) Submit
Expected_Result: Account created; user lands on role selection; verification flow per design

Title: Role selection: Executor
Steps:
1) Choose Executor
2) Continue
Expected_Result: Executor role stored; onboarding continues to Estate Basics

Title: Role selection: Heir
Steps:
1) Choose Heir
2) Continue
Expected_Result: Heir role stored; onboarding continues; heir gets viewer experience later

Title: Capture estate basics
Steps:
1) Enter deceased name
2) Enter date of death
3) Select state
4) Enter approx estate value
5) Save
Expected_Result: Estate record created; values persisted; next step shown

Title: Legal flags stored
Steps:
1) Set Will exists=Yes
2) Surviving spouse=No
3) Out-of-state property=Yes
4) Save
Expected_Result: Flags persist and are used by Track Scout and roadmap branching

Title: Track decision with statute citation
Steps:
1) Complete Track Scout step
2) View decision rationale panel
Expected_Result: Track chosen; rationale shows threshold inputs + statute citation; decision stored for audit

Title: Track decision changes when inputs change
Steps:
1) Edit estate value to cross threshold
2) Re-run / auto-update Track Scout
3) Review change log
Expected_Result: Track re-evaluated; change captured in audit log; user notified of implications

Title: Unsupported state handling
Preconditions: Estate basics set to non-supported state
Steps:
1) Select a state with no rules configured
2) Run Track Scout
Expected_Result: App clearly indicates limitation; offers generic guidance + prompt to consult attorney; no misleading track

Title: Initialize 6-phase roadmap
Steps:
1) Navigate to Roadmap
2) Confirm phases and tasks visible
Expected_Result: All 6 phases visible; tasks reflect track and flags; progress initially 0%

Title: Phase gating and completion
Steps:
1) Complete a task in Phase 1
2) Verify progress updates
3) Mark remaining Phase 1 tasks complete
Expected_Result: Progress updates; next phase becomes available per workflow rules

Title: Coverage matrix requires review of all asset classes
Steps:
1) Open Coverage Matrix
2) Attempt to mark discovery complete without reviewing all classes
Expected_Result: Discovery cannot be marked complete; missing classes are listed with required actions

Title: Negative assurance log creation
Preconditions: Estate in Phase 3; asset class selected
Steps:
1) Select Digital Assets class
2) Add Negative Finding note
3) Save
Test_Data: note='Searched tax returns and email; no crypto evidence found'
Expected_Result: Negative assurance entry stored, timestamped, and linked to class; appears in dossier

Title: Upload document and extract leads
Preconditions: Estate in Phase 3; user has doc file
Steps:
1) Upload tax return PDF
2) Run analysis
3) Review potential findings with source snippet citations
Expected_Result: Potential leads listed with confidence score + source citations; no auto-add without confirmation
Notes: Automation depends on test fixtures for PDF parsing

Title: Confirm lead adds to asset ledger
Steps:
1) Click 'Add to Ledger' on a finding
2) Open asset ledger
Expected_Result: Asset created with type/institution/value (if present); status=Discovered; back-reference to source doc

Title: Reject lead does not create asset
Steps:
1) Dismiss a finding
2) Search ledger for it
Expected_Result: No asset created; dismissal recorded for audit (optional)

Title: Asset status transitions
Steps:
1) Set status Discovered->Contacted
2) Add communication log
3) Set Documents Submitted
4) Set In Review
5) Set Approved
6) Set Distributed
Expected_Result: Status transitions persist; timeline/audit reflects changes; invalid transitions blocked per rules (if any)

Title: Add liability and classify priority
Steps:
1) Add liability with type=Tax
2) Save
Expected_Result: Liability stored; priority class assigned per state rules; visible in claims ledger

Title: Solvency tracker flags insolvency
Steps:
1) Add assets totaling 10,000
2) Add liabilities totaling 25,000
3) View solvency indicator
Expected_Result: Insolvency alert triggers immediately; guidance displayed; recorded in audit log

Title: Premature distribution lock prevents final petition generation
Preconditions: Estate in Phase 6 attempt; creditor period not passed
Steps:
1) Set notice clock start date to today
2) Go to Distribution page
3) Attempt to generate final petition
Expected_Result: Generate button disabled; reason shown (days remaining); audit records blocked attempt

Title: Distribution lock auto-unlocks after statutory period
Preconditions: Notice clock started in past beyond threshold
Steps:
1) Set notice start date to > statutory period ago
2) Go to Distribution page
Expected_Result: Generate button enabled; dossier/petition generation allowed

Title: Priority violation signal on payment
Preconditions: Higher priority unpaid; attempt to pay lower priority
Steps:
1) Add unpaid Tax (high priority)
2) Add general credit card debt
3) Mark credit card as PAID
Expected_Result: System flags violation (block or warn per design); logs event; requires resolution/override path if allowed

Title: Auto-fill DE-111 from estate data
Steps:
1) Select form DE-111
2) Generate
3) Preview PDF fields
Expected_Result: PDF generated; fields pre-filled correctly; no sensitive fields leaked in preview logs
Notes: Automation depends on deterministic PDF field map fixtures

Title: Version history in vault
Preconditions: At least one generated document exists
Steps:
1) Generate DE-150 twice with changed data
2) Open vault version history
Expected_Result: Two versions stored; diff metadata captured; latest marked current

Title: Fax send workflow (PamFax)
Steps:
1) Choose doc
2) Send via fax
3) Attach confirmation to comm log
Expected_Result: Fax job created; status tracked; confirmation stored and linkable to asset

Title: Log communication with attachment
Steps:
1) Log Phone call
2) Add summary
3) Attach file
4) Save
Expected_Result: Comm entry stored; attachment encrypted/stored; visible on asset detail

Title: Follow-up reminders at 7/14/21/30 days
Steps:
1) Set last-contact date to 8 days ago
2) Run scheduler / open reminders
3) Verify reminder
Expected_Result: 7-day reminder created; escalates at 14/21/30 if still no response

Title: Escalation suggestion after non-response
Steps:
1) Set last-contact to 31 days ago
2) Check escalation suggestions
Expected_Result: Escalation options shown (letters/complaints) and can be generated/logged

Title: One-click export produces report with all required sections
Steps:
1) Navigate to Distribution
2) Click 'Export Dossier'
3) Open generated PDF/text
Expected_Result: Report includes: coverage matrix, negative assurance, inventory ledger, claims log, activity log; timestamps correct
Notes: Automation depends on deterministic report generator output checks

Title: Negative assurance included in dossier
Steps:
1) Create negative assurance
2) Export dossier
3) Search report text
Expected_Result: Negative assurance entry appears in report under correct category with timestamp

Title: Invite heir as VIEWER
Steps:
1) Settings > Team
2) Invite heir email as VIEWER
3) Heir accepts
4) Heir views dashboard
Expected_Result: Heir can view roadmap/progress and dossier; cannot edit assets/liabilities; access logged

Title: Invite attorney as ATTORNEY role
Steps:
1) Invite attorney
2) Attorney accepts
3) Verify permissions
Expected_Result: Attorney can view full records; optionally comment; cannot execute distributions unless allowed

Title: Co-executor can edit; viewer cannot
Steps:
1) Viewer tries to edit asset
2) Co-executor edits asset
3) Check audit log
Expected_Result: Viewer denied with clear message; co-executor allowed; both actions logged

Title: Sensitive fields encrypted at rest
Preconditions: DB access available for test env
Steps:
1) Create asset with account number
2) Inspect stored record
3) Verify ciphertext / envelope encryption
Expected_Result: Account numbers/SSNs not stored in plaintext; key management per design

Title: Access isolation across estates
Steps:
1) User A creates estate A
2) User B creates estate B
3) User A tries to access estate B via ID tampering
Expected_Result: Access denied; event logged; no data leakage in response payload

Title: Audit log immutability
Steps:
1) Attempt to edit/delete audit entry via API
2) Verify blocked
Expected_Result: Audit entries cannot be modified; only appended; admin access controlled

Title: Legal boundary notice displayed
Steps:
1) Open Trust/Limits page
2) Verify guarantee vs non-guarantee statements present
Expected_Result: Disclaimers present; no UPL language; users can access from footer

Title: Upload unsupported file type
Steps: 1) Upload .exe or unknown type
Expected_Result: Upload rejected; message shown; no processing; security event logged

Title: Generate form without required data
Steps:
1) Select DE-111
2) Generate
Expected_Result: Validation error with missing fields; no partial PDF produced; remediation guidance shown

Title: Manual override flow requires explicit acknowledgment
Preconditions: Violation exists; override enabled by policy
Steps:
1) Trigger priority violation
2) Choose override
3) Provide reason + acknowledgment
Expected_Result: Override requires explicit confirmation; reason stored; shows up in dossier/audit
